observations: I opened assets/panels/02-4.png, workflow/review/page-02.png and main-cast.png with Read and looked at them.

This is a wide two-shot in warm evening light. Ananya sits at left, turned toward Meera, speaking with a smile. Meera stands at right, smiling back. Both match their sheets: Ananya has her bun, stud, white coat, teal kurta and stethoscope; Meera has her braid over the left shoulder, blue kurta and bangle.

The hands match production. Ananya's right hand (screen-left) is raised in a small encouraging fist, and her left hand rests on the desk beside the laptop. Meera's right hand, with the bangle, holds the staff phone low at her side. Her left hand hangs relaxed at the right edge.

The laptop between them faces the reader and shows only blank fields with faint placeholder bars and a button. The phone shows a calendar icon and blank cards. Neither has readable text. The framed leaf print and the bookshelf spines are plain.
On page-02.png the balloon sits between the two women over the window area. Its tail goes to Ananya's mouth. Both faces, Ananya's fist, the laptop and Meera's phone (protected area) are uncovered.
